title: 第6课 · 怎么突然找不到了
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 6 — 怎么突然找不到了 · Why are they suddenly missing

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在客厅 — In the living room

items.py: yǎnjìng
items.en: glasses, spectacles

items.py: tūrán
items.en: suddenly

items.py: lí kāi
items.en: to leave, to part with

items.py: qīngchu
items.en: clear, distinct

items.py: gāngcái
items.en: just now

items.py: bāng máng
items.en: to help

items.zh: 周明：我的眼镜呢？怎么突然找不到了？你看见了吗？
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Wǒ de yǎnjìng ne? Zěnme tūrán zhǎo bu dào le? Nǐ kànjiàn le ma?
items.en: Zhou Ming: Where are my glasses? Why can't I find them all of a sudden? Have you seen them?

items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Wǒ méi kànjiàn a.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: I haven't seen them.

items.zh: 周明：我离不开眼镜，没有眼镜，我一个字也看不清楚。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Wǒ lí bu kāi yǎnjìng, méiyǒu yǎnjìng, wǒ yī ge zì yě kàn bu qīngchu.
items.en: Zhou Ming: I can't do without my glasses. Without them I can't read a single character clearly.

items.zh: 周太太：你去房间找找，是不是刚才放在桌子上了？
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Nǐ qù fángjiān zhǎozhao, shì bu shì gāngcái fàng zài zhuōzi shang le?
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Go and look in the room. Didn't you just put them on the table?

items.zh: 周明：我怎么看得到啊？你快过来帮忙啊。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Wǒ zěnme kàn de dào a? Nǐ kuài guòlai bāng máng a.
items.en: Zhou Ming: How could I see them? Come here and help me, quick.

items.zh: 周太太：好吧，我帮你去找找。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Hǎo ba, wǒ bāng nǐ qù zhǎozhao.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: All right, I'll help you look.

items.zh: 同学：今天的作业你做完了吗？
items.py: Tóngxué: Jīntiān de zuòyè nǐ zuòwán le ma?
items.en: Classmate: Have you finished today's homework?

items.py: Érzi: Gāng zuòwán, nǐ ne?
items.en: Son: I just finished. How about you?

items.zh: 同学：今天这些题特别难，我看不懂，不会做，你能帮我吗？
items.py: Tóngxué: Jīntiān zhèxiē tí tèbié nán, wǒ kàn bu dǒng, bù huì zuò, nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma?
items.en: Classmate: Today's questions are really hard. I don't understand them and can't do them. Can you help me?

items.zh: 儿子：电话里讲不明白，你来我家吧，我给你讲讲。
items.py: Érzi: Diànhuà li jiǎng bu míngbai, nǐ lái wǒ jiā ba, wǒ gěi nǐ jiǎngjiang.
items.en: Son: I can't explain it clearly over the phone. Come to my place and I'll explain it to you.

items.zh: 同学：好啊，我锻炼完了就过去。
items.py: Tóngxué: Hǎo a, wǒ duànliàn wán le jiù guòqu.
items.en: Classmate: Great, I'll come over as soon as I finish exercising.

items.zh: 周太太：你怎么还喝咖啡？
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Nǐ zěnme hái hē kāfēi?
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Why are you still drinking coffee?

items.py: Zhōu Míng: Zěnme le?
items.en: Zhou Ming: What's wrong?

items.zh: 周太太：你不是说晚上睡不着觉吗？
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Nǐ bù shì shuō wǎnshang shuì bu zháo jiào ma?
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Didn't you say you can't fall asleep at night?

items.py: Zhōu Míng: Méi shì, wǒ zhǐ hē yī bēi.
items.en: Zhou Ming: It's fine, I'm only having one cup.

items.zh: 周太太：你还是喝杯牛奶吧，可以睡得更好些。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Nǐ háishi hē bēi niúnǎi ba, kěyǐ shuì de gèng hǎo xiē.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: You'd better have a glass of milk instead; you'll sleep better.

items.py: Zhōu Míng: Hǎo ba, niúnǎi ne?
items.en: Zhou Ming: OK. Where's the milk?

items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Hái méi mǎi ne.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: We haven't bought any yet.
